---
title: "Developmental ToM: cross-task fine-tuning transfer"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  results_dir: "data/processed/finetune"   # one subfolder per model, then per revision
  source_order: !r c("fb", "antagonist", "attn_agent")
  target_order: !r c("fb", "antagonist", "attn_agent", "attn_loc")
  use_log2: false                          # true = report log-odds in base 2
  save_png: true                           # also save each figure to figures/
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5)
library(tidyverse)
```

Each cell is the mean change in log-odds of the correct answer on the **test task**
(columns) after fine-tuning on the **train task** (rows), relative to the base
model. Every cell is scored on held-out stories (4-fold CV over stories), so each
item is tested once per seed. Values are averaged over items, then over seeds.
Outlined cells are within-task. `attn_loc` (location attention checks) is
evaluated but never trained on.

Correct answers: **fb** = the protagonist's belief (start location for False
Belief, end location for True Belief); **antagonist** = end location in both
conditions (the antagonist moved the object); **attn_agent** = the person who
placed / moved the object; **attn_loc** = the start / end location.

```{r load}
# Look for the results folder from the working directory, then one or two
# levels up (e.g. if this Rmd lives in analysis/).
results_dir <- params$results_dir
for (prefix in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
  if (dir.exists(file.path(prefix, params$results_dir))) {
    results_dir <- file.path(prefix, params$results_dir)
    break
  }
}
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) {
  stop("Can't find the results folder '", params$results_dir, "'. ",
       "This Rmd is looking in: ", normalizePath("."),
       ". Set results_dir in the header to the full path of your results folder.")
}

# data/processed/finetune/<model>/<revision>/ft_*.csv
run_dirs <- list.dirs(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
run_dirs <- run_dirs[map_lgl(run_dirs, \(d)
  length(list.files(d, pattern = "^ft_.*\\.csv$")) > 0)]
if (length(run_dirs) == 0) {
  stop("No ft_*.csv files found under ", normalizePath(results_dir))
}

stage_levels <- c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Pretrained", "SFT", "DPO", "Instruct")

# Short, readable label for each checkpoint, e.g. "13B Stage 1", "7B SFT".
# Falls back to "<model> @ <revision>" for anything that doesn't match.
checkpoint_info <- function(model_name, revision) {
  size <- str_extract(model_name, "\\d+B")
  stage <- case_when(
    str_detect(model_name, "-Instruct$") ~ "Instruct",
    str_detect(model_name, "-DPO$") ~ "DPO",
    str_detect(model_name, "-SFT$") ~ "SFT",
    str_detect(revision, "^stage1") ~ "Stage 1",
    str_detect(revision, "^stage2") ~ "Stage 2",
    revision == "main" ~ "Pretrained",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  label <- if (!is.na(size) && !is.na(stage)) paste(size, stage) else
    paste0(model_name, " @ ", revision)
  list(size = size, stage = stage, label = label)
}

read_run <- function(dir) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "^ft_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  info <- checkpoint_info(basename(dirname(dir)), basename(dir))
  map_dfr(files, \(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE,
                               col_types = cols(question_id = col_double(),
                                                .default = col_guess()))) |>
    select(-any_of(c("model", "revision"))) |>
    mutate(model = info$label, size = info$size, stage = info$stage)
}

log_scale <- if (isTRUE(params$use_log2)) log(2) else 1
units <- if (isTRUE(params$use_log2)) "log2" else "natural log"

question_labels <- c(`1` = "Original location", `2` = "Final location",
                     `3` = "Who placed", `4` = "Who moved")

scores <- map_dfr(run_dirs, read_run) |>
  rename(target = task) |>
  mutate(
    score = score / log_scale,
    base_score = base_score / log_scale,
    gain = score - base_score,
    passage = condition,                     # FB vs. TB story, for every task
    # For the attention checks, "condition" is the question type
    condition = if_else(is.na(question_id), condition,
                        unname(question_labels[as.character(question_id)])),
    source = factor(source, levels = params$source_order),
    target = factor(target, levels = params$target_order)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(source), !is.na(target))

condition_levels <- c("False Belief", "True Belief", unname(question_labels))
scores <- mutate(scores, condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels))

# Checkpoint order: by model size, then training stage
model_info <- scores |>
  distinct(model, size, stage) |>
  mutate(size_num = as.numeric(str_remove(size, "B")),
         stage_num = match(stage, stage_levels)) |>
  arrange(size_num, stage_num, model)
model_order <- model_info$model
sizes <- unique(na.omit(model_info$size))

# Per-item values averaged over seeds (used by the item-level plots)
items <- scores |>
  group_by(model, source, target, item_id, question_id, condition, passage) |>
  summarise(base = mean(base_score), after = mean(score),
            gain = mean(gain), n_seeds = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r summarise}
# Mean gain per seed, then mean and SE across seeds
per_seed <- scores |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target) |>
  summarise(gain = mean(gain, na.rm = TRUE), n_folds = n_distinct(fold),
            .groups = "drop")

cells <- per_seed |>
  group_by(model, source, target) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(gain), sd = sd(gain), n_seeds = n(),
            min_folds = min(n_folds), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n_seeds))
```

## Runs found

```{r runs}
scores |>
  distinct(model, source, seed, fold) |>
  group_by(model, source) |>
  summarise(Seeds = paste(sort(unique(seed)), collapse = ", "),
            `Folds per seed` = paste(sort(unique(fold)), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(Model = model, `Train task` = source) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Log-odds units: `r units`. If a run is incomplete (not all 4 folds), a cell only
covers some stories, so compare cells with care.

```{r plot-fn}
plot_matrix <- function(d, title) {
  lim <- max(abs(d$mean), na.rm = TRUE)
  diag <- filter(d, as.character(source) == as.character(target))
  seeds <- range(d$n_seeds)
  subtitle <- paste0(
    if (seeds[1] == seeds[2]) paste0(seeds[1], " seed(s)") else
      paste0(seeds[1], "-", seeds[2], " seeds per cell"),
    if (min(d$min_folds) < 4) " (some folds missing)" else "")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = target, y = fct_rev(source), fill = mean)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_tile(data = diag, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean),
                  color = abs(mean) > 0.6 * lim), size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B2182B", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                         name = "Δ log-odds\ncorrect") +
    labs(x = "Test task", y = "Train task", title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

safe_name <- function(m) str_replace_all(m, "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_")
if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Summary figure: accuracy by training condition

Accuracy on fb and antagonist, by condition, for the base model and after
fine-tuning on each task. One figure per model size.
Small faint points are individual checkpoints (training stages), each averaged
over seeds. Large points are the mean across those checkpoints, with ±1 SE
across checkpoints.

```{r summary-data}
condition_colors <- c("False Belief" = "#D95F02", "True Belief" = "#1B9E77",
                      "Original location" = "#D95F02", "Final location" = "#1B9E77",
                      "Who placed" = "#7570B3", "Who moved" = "#999999")
train_levels <- c("None (base)", "FB", "Antagonist", "Agent identity")
train_labels <- c(fb = "FB", antagonist = "Antagonist", attn_agent = "Agent identity")

# Fine-tuned accuracy, per seed
summ_ft <- scores |>
  filter(target %in% c("fb", "antagonist")) |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target, condition) |>
  summarise(acc = 100 * mean(score > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(training = unname(train_labels[as.character(source)])) |>
  select(-source)

# Base accuracy (one value per item; the same whichever task was trained on)
summ_base <- scores |>
  filter(target %in% c("fb", "antagonist")) |>
  distinct(model, target, item_id, condition, base_score) |>
  group_by(model, target, condition) |>
  summarise(acc = 100 * mean(base_score > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(seed = NA, training = "None (base)")

summ <- bind_rows(summ_ft, summ_base) |>
  group_by(model, training, target, condition) |>
  summarise(se = sd(acc) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(acc))), acc = mean(acc),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0),
         size = str_extract(model, "\\d+B"),
         training = factor(training, levels = train_levels),
         target = factor(target, levels = c("fb", "antagonist"),
                         labels = c("Test: FB", "Test: Antagonist")))

# One point per checkpoint, and the mean across checkpoints of each size
summ_mean <- summ |>
  group_by(size, training, target, condition) |>
  summarise(n_ckpt = n(), se = sd(acc) / sqrt(n()), acc = mean(acc),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0))

plot_summary <- function(sz) {
  pts <- filter(summ, size == sz)
  means <- filter(summ_mean, size == sz)
  n_ckpt <- n_distinct(pts$model)
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ggplot(means, aes(x = training, y = acc, color = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(data = pts, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.35,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0,
                                               dodge.width = 0.5, seed = 1)) +
    geom_point(position = dodge, size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = acc - se, ymax = acc + se),
                  position = dodge, width = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    facet_wrap(~ target) +
    labs(x = "Fine-tuned on", y = "Accuracy (%)",
         title = paste0("OLMo 2 ", sz),
         subtitle = paste0("Mean of ", n_ckpt,
                           " checkpoints (±1 SE); faint points = individual checkpoints")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r summary-plot, results = "asis", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
for (sz in intersect(sizes, summ$size)) {
  cat("\n\n### OLMo 2 ", sz, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_summary(sz)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("summary_", sz, ".png")),
           p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Trade-off: change on fb vs. change on antagonist

Each training condition as two numbers: the change in accuracy on **fb** (x)
and on **antagonist** (y), relative to the base model, using False Belief items
only. Points in the top-left or bottom-right helped one task at the expense of
the other. Large points are the mean across checkpoints (±1 SE in both
directions); faint points are individual checkpoints. One panel per model size.

```{r tradeoff-data}
tradeoff_ckpt <- summ |>
  filter(condition == "False Belief") |>
  select(model, size, training, target, acc) |>
  group_by(model, size, target) |>
  mutate(delta = acc - acc[training == "None (base)"]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(training != "None (base)") |>
  select(-acc) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = target, values_from = delta) |>
  rename(d_fb = `Test: FB`, d_ant = `Test: Antagonist`) |>
  mutate(size = factor(size, levels = sizes))

tradeoff_mean <- tradeoff_ckpt |>
  group_by(size, training) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            se_fb = sd(d_fb) / sqrt(n), d_fb = mean(d_fb),
            se_ant = sd(d_ant) / sqrt(n), d_ant = mean(d_ant),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(se_fb, se_ant), \(x) replace_na(x, 0)))

training_colors <- c("FB" = "#D95F02", "Antagonist" = "#7570B3",
                     "Agent identity" = "#1B9E77")
```

```{r tradeoff-plot, fig.width = 4.5 * length(sizes) + 1.5, fig.height = 5}
p_tradeoff <- ggplot(tradeoff_mean, aes(x = d_fb, y = d_ant, color = training)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = tradeoff_ckpt, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = d_ant - se_ant, ymax = d_ant + se_ant), width = 0) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = d_fb - se_fb, xmax = d_fb + se_fb), height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = training_colors, name = "Fine-tuned on") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~ size, labeller = labeller(size = \(x) paste("OLMo 2", x))) +
  labs(x = "Δ accuracy on fb (pp, False Belief items)",
       y = "Δ accuracy on antagonist (pp, False Belief items)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_tradeoff
if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
  ggsave(file.path("figures", "tradeoff.png"), p_tradeoff,
         width = 4.5 * length(sizes) + 1.5, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

```{r tradeoff-table}
tradeoff_mean |>
  transmute(Size = size, `Fine-tuned on` = training,
            `Δ fb (pp)` = sprintf("%+.0f (%.0f)", d_fb, se_fb),
            `Δ antagonist (pp)` = sprintf("%+.0f (%.0f)", d_ant, se_ant)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Mean change from base, False Belief items (SE across checkpoints)")
```

## Gain by condition

Mean gain for each condition of each test task (fb and antagonist: False vs.
True Belief; attention checks: question type). Error bars are ±1 SE across
seeds. Orange marks answers that match the protagonist's outdated view (False
Belief, original location); green marks answers that match current reality
(True Belief, final location).

How to read a shift toward one location:

- **fb**: a general shift toward the end location shows up as False Belief
  down and True Belief up. If both go up, the change depends on the condition.
- **antagonist**: the correct answer is the end location in *both* conditions,
  so a general shift toward the end location makes both go up. Compare with
  fb to tell real agent tracking apart from that shift.

```{r condition-fn}
by_condition <- scores |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target, condition) |>
  summarise(gain = mean(gain), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(model, source, target, condition) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(gain), se = sd(gain) / sqrt(n()), n_seeds = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0))

condition_colors <- c("False Belief" = "#D95F02", "True Belief" = "#1B9E77",
                      "Original location" = "#D95F02", "Final location" = "#1B9E77",
                      "Who placed" = "#7570B3", "Who moved" = "#999999")

plot_condition <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
    facet_grid(source ~ target, scales = "free_x",
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x),
                                   target = \(x) paste("Test:", x))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ log-odds correct", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r condition-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7}
for (m in intersect(model_order, by_condition$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_condition(filter(by_condition, model == m), m)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("condition_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Attention checks by passage type

Gain on each attention-check question, split by whether it was asked about a
False Belief or a True Belief passage. If a fine-tuned model answers based on
the type of story rather than the question, it should favor the original
location (and the person who placed the object) on False Belief passages, and
the final location (and the person who moved it) on True Belief passages,
whatever the question asks.

```{r attn-passage}
attn_sum <- scores |>
  filter(target %in% c("attn_agent", "attn_loc")) |>
  mutate(passage = paste(passage, "passage")) |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, condition, passage) |>
  summarise(gain = mean(gain), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(model, source, condition, passage) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(gain), se = sd(gain) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0))
```

```{r attn-passage-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
for (m in intersect(model_order, attn_sum$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- filter(attn_sum, model == m) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = passage)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("False Belief passage" = "#D95F02",
                                 "True Belief passage" = "#1B9E77"), name = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x))) +
    labs(x = "Attention-check question", y = "Δ log-odds correct", title = m) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("attn_passage_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Accuracy

Change in accuracy (percentage points), where an item counts as correct if the
model gives the correct answer higher probability than the incorrect one.
Labels show accuracy before → after fine-tuning.

```{r accuracy-data}
acc_cells <- scores |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target) |>
  summarise(acc_base = mean(base_score > 0), acc_after = mean(score > 0),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(model, source, target) |>
  summarise(acc_base = mean(acc_base), acc_after = mean(acc_after),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(delta = 100 * (acc_after - acc_base),
         label = sprintf("%+.0f\n(%.0f→%.0f)", delta, 100 * acc_base, 100 * acc_after))

plot_accuracy <- function(d, title) {
  lim <- max(abs(d$delta), 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  diag <- filter(d, as.character(source) == as.character(target))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = target, y = fct_rev(source), fill = delta)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_tile(data = diag, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.3, lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B2182B", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                         name = "Δ accuracy\n(pp)") +
    labs(x = "Test task", y = "Train task", title = title) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}
```

```{r accuracy-plots, results = "asis"}
for (m in intersect(model_order, acc_cells$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_accuracy(filter(acc_cells, model == m), m)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("accuracy_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Accuracy by condition

Same layout as "Gain by condition", but showing the change in accuracy
(percentage points). Error bars are ±1 SE across seeds. Labels under each bar
show accuracy before → after fine-tuning.

```{r acc-condition-data}
acc_by_condition <- scores |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target, condition) |>
  summarise(acc_base = mean(base_score > 0), acc_after = mean(score > 0),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(delta = 100 * (acc_after - acc_base)) |>
  group_by(model, source, target, condition) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(delta), se = sd(delta) / sqrt(n()),
            acc_base = mean(acc_base), acc_after = mean(acc_after),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0),
         label = sprintf("%.0f→%.0f", 100 * acc_base, 100 * acc_after))

plot_acc_condition <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = -100, label = label), size = 2.8, vjust = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
    facet_grid(source ~ target, scales = "free_x",
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x),
                                   target = \(x) paste("Test:", x))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ accuracy (pp)", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r acc-condition-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7}
for (m in intersect(model_order, acc_by_condition$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_acc_condition(filter(acc_by_condition, model == m), m)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("acc_condition_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Accuracy change across training stages

One figure per test task. Each line is the change in accuracy (percentage
points) on that test task after fine-tuning on the row's training task, at
each training stage. Columns are model sizes. Error bars are ±1 SE across
seeds. Stages: Stage 1 (last stage-1 checkpoint), Stage 2 (last stage-2
checkpoint), Pretrained (final base model), then the SFT, DPO and Instruct
models.

```{r stage-data}
acc_by_stage <- acc_by_condition |>
  left_join(select(model_info, model, size, stage), by = "model") |>
  filter(!is.na(stage), !is.na(size)) |>
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = stage_levels),
         size = factor(size, levels = sizes))

plot_stage <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = stage, y = mean, color = condition, group = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
    facet_grid(source ~ size,
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x))) +
    labs(x = "Training stage", y = "Δ accuracy (pp)", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r stage-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
if (nrow(acc_by_stage) == 0) {
  cat("No runs with recognizable training stages found.")
}
for (t in levels(droplevels(acc_by_stage$target))) {
  cat("\n\n### Test: ", t, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_stage(filter(acc_by_stage, target == t), paste("Test:", t))
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("stages_test_", t, ".png")), p,
           width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Accuracy before and after fine-tuning, across stages

Same layout as above, but showing accuracy itself rather than the change:
dashed lines are the base model, solid lines are after fine-tuning. This makes
ceiling and floor effects visible (a condition already near 100% has little
room to improve).

```{r stage-ba-data}
acc_stage_ba <- acc_by_stage |>
  select(size, stage, source, target, condition, acc_base, acc_after) |>
  pivot_longer(c(acc_base, acc_after), names_to = "phase", values_to = "acc") |>
  mutate(acc = 100 * acc,
         phase = factor(recode(phase, acc_base = "Base", acc_after = "Fine-tuned"),
                        levels = c("Base", "Fine-tuned")))

plot_stage_ba <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = stage, y = acc, color = condition, linetype = phase,
                group = interaction(condition, phase))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = phase), size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Base = "dashed", `Fine-tuned` = "solid"),
                          name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Base = 1, `Fine-tuned` = 16), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    facet_grid(source ~ size,
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x))) +
    labs(x = "Training stage", y = "Accuracy (%)", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r stage-ba-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
for (t in levels(droplevels(acc_stage_ba$target))) {
  cat("\n\n### Test: ", t, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_stage_ba(filter(acc_stage_ba, target == t), paste("Test:", t))
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("stages_ba_test_", t, ".png")), p,
           width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Explicit vs. implicit probe

Mean gain on fb and antagonist, split by how the final question is worded
(explicit "thinks the X is in the" vs. implicit, e.g. "goes to get the X from
the"). Error bars are ±1 SE across seeds.

```{r cue-data}
by_cue <- scores |>
  filter(target %in% c("fb", "antagonist")) |>
  group_by(model, seed, source, target, condition, knowledge_cue) |>
  summarise(gain = mean(gain), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(model, source, target, condition, knowledge_cue) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(gain), se = sd(gain) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(se = replace_na(se, 0))

plot_cue <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = knowledge_cue, y = mean, fill = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, name = NULL) +
    facet_grid(source ~ target,
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x),
                                   target = \(x) paste("Test:", x))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ log-odds correct", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r cue-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7}
for (m in intersect(model_order, by_cue$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_cue(filter(by_cue, model == m), m)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("cue_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Item-level: before vs. after

Each point is one item (averaged over seeds): log-odds of the correct answer
for the base model (x) and after fine-tuning (y). Points above the diagonal
improved; points right of the vertical line were already correct before
fine-tuning, and points above the horizontal line are correct after.

```{r item-fn}
plot_items <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = base, y = after, color = condition)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, name = "Condition") +
    facet_grid(source ~ target,
               labeller = labeller(source = \(x) paste("Train:", x),
                                   target = \(x) paste("Test:", x))) +
    labs(x = "Base model log-odds", y = "Fine-tuned log-odds", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r item-plots, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
for (m in intersect(model_order, items$model)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", m, "\n\n")
  p <- plot_items(filter(items, model == m), m)
  print(p)
  if (isTRUE(params$save_png)) {
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0("items_", safe_name(m), ".png")), p,
           width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Table: mean (SE across seeds)

```{r table}
cells |>
  mutate(value = if_else(n_seeds > 1,
                         sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean, se),
                         sprintf("%.2f", mean))) |>
  select(model, source, target, value) |>
  arrange(target) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = target, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(model, source) |>
  rename(Model = model, `Train task` = source) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
